noAccess.title: You cannot open this
noAccess.body: This needs the permission {permission}. Ask an administrator to give it to your role.

warning.WIDTH_UNKNOWN: A roll's width is not known: check it fits the marker.
warning.SHRINKAGE_UNKNOWN: A roll's shrinkage is not known.
warning.SHADE_UNKNOWN: A roll's shade is not known: the lay may mix shades.
warning.LOT_NOT_RELEASED: A roll's lot is still in quarantine.
warning.SHADES_ACROSS_LAYS: The lays are cut from different shade groups: keep each lay's garments together when bundling.
warning.SHRINKAGE_ACROSS_LAYS: The lays are cut from different shrinkage groups: keep each lay's garments together when bundling.

refusal.NOT_PLANNED: The plan changes only while the cut order is planned (send it back to planning first).
refusal.NOT_AT_TABLE: This cut order is not released to the cutting table.
refusal.NOT_OPEN: This cut order is cut, reconciled or cancelled: it does not change any more.
refusal.TICKET_SCANNED: A ticket of this cut order was scanned at the table already: it cannot go back to planning or be cancelled.
refusal.NO_LINE: This cut order has no work order size yet.
refusal.NO_MARKER: A fabric cut order is released with its marker (name and length).
refusal.LAYS_PLIES: The lays' plies do not add up to the marker's plies: plan the lays again.
refusal.WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN: A work order picked is not released or running any more.
refusal.WORK_ORDER_ON_HOLD: A work order picked is on hold: nothing is cut for it.
refusal.WORK_ORDER_OTHER_SITE: A work order picked is of another site than the cut order.
refusal.NOT_THE_MATERIAL: A size picked does not take this material and colour.
refusal.NOT_A_CUT_MATERIAL: This material is not cut by hide or by length.
refusal.CELL_FULL: Another cut order took garments of a size meanwhile: fewer are left than asked. The sizes were read again.
refusal.ROLL_NOT_IN_STOCK: This roll is not in stock here.
refusal.ROLL_OTHER_MATERIAL: This roll is of another material or colour.
refusal.ROLL_TOO_NARROW: This roll is narrower than the marker.
refusal.ROLL_REJECTED: This roll was rejected at incoming inspection.
refusal.LOT_HELD: This roll's lot is on hold.
refusal.LOT_NOT_USABLE: This roll's lot is rejected or blocked.
refusal.ROLL_SHORT: Not even one whole ply is left on this roll.
refusal.MIXED_SHADE: One lay is cut from one shade group: this roll's shade differs from the lay's other rolls.
refusal.MIXED_SHRINKAGE: One lay is cut from one shrinkage group: this roll's group differs from the lay's other rolls.
refusal.LAY_FULL: The lay has all its plies already.
refusal.LAY_NOT_PLANNED: This lay is at the table already: its rolls are changed there.
refusal.TICKET_DONE: This ticket is done: its cut is finished.
refusal.TICKET_NOT_STARTED: This ticket was not started at the table.
refusal.TICKET_IS_RECUT: This is a recut ticket: it is handled with the recuts.
refusal.CUT_ORDER_NOT_RELEASED: The cut order is not released: its tickets are not cut now.
refusal.PLIES_NOT_COUNTED: The lay's plies were not counted at both ends yet.
refusal.NOT_CUT: A cut order is reconciled once it is cut.
refusal.FABRIC_NOT_CONFIRMED: The fabric used on a cut lay is not confirmed at the table yet: it is confirmed first (that issues the fabric to the work orders).
refusal.FLOOR_NOT_READY: This site's floor is not ready for real work yet.

problem.forbidden: You may not do or see this.
problem.offline: The factory server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
problem.write: This was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed this meanwhile. It was read again: check and try again.
problem.invalid: The request was refused as it is. Check the fields.

field.ratio: A size's ratio is not right (whole garments in one ply).
field.quantity: A size's garments are not right.
field.lines: A size picked is not right any more: read the sizes again.
field.marker: The marker's name, length or width is not right.
field.lays: The lays' plies are not right.
field.station: The table is not a station of this site.
field.printer: Pick a label printer of this site (several are there), or show the label only.
field.rolls: A roll picked is not right any more: read the rolls again.

held.reason: Say why in at least 3 characters.

release.status: Only a planned cut order is released.

back.status: Only a released cut order goes back to planning.
back.started: A ticket was scanned or a lay is at the table: it cannot go back to planning.

cancel.status: Only a planned or released cut order is cancelled.
cancel.started: A ticket was scanned at the table: it cannot be cancelled.

reconcile.notCut: A cut order is reconciled once every lay is cut.
reconcile.done: This cut order is reconciled already.

rolls.leather: Leather is cut hide by hide: hides are allocated to each work order.
rolls.notReleased: Rolls are allocated once the cut order is released.
rolls.layAtTable: Lay {seq} is at the table: its rolls are changed there.

ticket.done: This ticket is done: its cut is finished.

list.ordersFailed: The cut orders could not be read

newOrder.title: New cut order
newOrder.body: Work orders of one material and colour, cut together at one table: fabric in lays from one marker, leather hide by hide.
newOrder.failed: The work orders waiting could not be read

empty.title: Nothing waits for a cut order
empty.body: Every released work order's size is already on a cut order of its material.

newOrder.materialHint: One material and colour at one site: its sizes of every work order waiting.
newOrder.markerLengthHint: One ply's length on the table, at most 50 m.
newOrder.markerWidthHint: A roll narrower than this is refused.
newOrder.pliesHint: Every size of the marker is cut on every ply.
newOrder.laysHint: How many lays the plies are split in.
newOrder.leather: Leather is cut hide by hide: type each size's garments (empty: what is left). The hides are allocated to each work order afterwards.
newOrder.tableHint: Optional: the ticket prints on its label printer.
newOrder.tableNoRight: Picking a table needs print.view; it can be left empty.

why.full: Nothing is left of this size: other cut orders of this material cut all of it.

held.group: Pick a material and colour first.
held.tooMany: At most {max} sizes on one cut order.
held.markerLength: The marker's length in metres, above 0 and at most {max}.
held.markerWidth: The usable width in cm, above 0 and at most {max}.
held.lays: The lays, from 1 to {max} (no lay without a ply).
held.layTooHigh: A lay holds at most {max} plies: split them in more lays.
held.ratio: {cell}: the garments in one ply, a whole number from 1 to {max}.
held.quantity: {cell}: the garments, a whole number from 1.
held.due: The due day is not a day.

held.title_one: {count} work order on hold: the table cuts nothing for it
held.title_other: {count} work orders on hold: the table cuts nothing for them

forbidden.title: You cannot open this cut order
forbidden.body: It belongs to a company or site you may not see.

missing.title: This cut order does not exist
missing.body: It was not found. It may belong to another company.

error.title: The cut order could not be read

marker.title: Marker
marker.name: Marker
marker.none: No marker yet: a fabric cut order is released with its marker.
marker.cad: The marker is typed (name, length, width); importing a CAD marker file comes later.

lays.title: Lays

empty.title: No lay
empty.body: A fabric cut order splits its plies into lays when it is planned.

lays.hint: Each lay is spread from one shade and one shrinkage group; its ticket is scanned at the start and at the end of cutting.
lays.cancelled_one: {count} lay was cancelled when the plan changed.
lays.cancelled_other: {count} lays were cancelled when the plan changed.
lays.allocateHint: Open a lay to allocate its rolls: the proposal fills each lay from one shade group, ends and part rolls first.

lines.title: Work orders and sizes
lines.hint: Every size of the marker is cut on every ply: a size's garments = its ratio × the plies. Released: {when}.

hides.title: Hides
hides.body: Leather is cut hide by hide for each work order: the hides allocated and cut, their area and the same shade lot check are on each work order's cut.

pieces.hintFabric: Cut = the size's ratio × the plies counted on the lays already cut; recut = recut tickets done since the release.
pieces.hintLeather: Cut = the work order's cut log for the size, less what earlier leather cut orders reconciled.

yield.title: Yield
yield.never: Per lay and roll; never by cutter.
yield.leather: Leather's yield is per hide: each work order's cut has its yield per hide, lot and supplier.

none.title: No lay cut yet
none.body: The fabric used appears here once a lay is cut and its fabric is confirmed at the table.

material.unconfirmed_one: The fabric used on lay {lays} is not confirmed yet: it counts at the lay report's figure.
material.unconfirmed_other: The fabric used on lays {lays} is not confirmed yet: they count at the lay report's figures.
material.hint: Issued = posted to the work orders at the confirmation; used = the cutter's confirmed figure; ends returned stay on their roll in stock.

tickets.title: Cut tickets

empty.title: No ticket
empty.body: Every ticket of this cut order was voided.
empty.planned: Tickets are made when the cut order is released: one per lay, one for leather.

tickets.hint: A lost ticket is voided with the reason and a new one made for the same lay; a void ticket never scans again.

print.printerHint: Default: the table's label printer, else the site's only one.
print.showOnly: Show the label only (do not print)

held.showOne: Show one label at a time.

void.title: Void {number}
void.body: The ticket will never scan again. The lay keeps its rolls and plies.
void.replace: Make a new ticket for the same lay

back.title: {number} back to planning
back.body: Its open tickets are voided and its rolls taken off the lays; the plan can then change.

cancel.title: Cancel {number}
cancel.body: Its open tickets are voided and its lays cancelled; its work orders' sizes are free for another cut order.

rolls.title: Rolls for lay {seq} · {number}
rolls.body: Lay {seq} takes {plies} plies; its rolls give {allocated}. Tick rolls of one shade and one shrinkage group.
rolls.noneOnLay: No roll on this lay yet.
rolls.noProposal: No proposal for this lay: no group of rolls fits it.
rolls.perPly: One ply takes {metres} m off a roll (allowance {allowance} cm).

empty.title: No roll of this fabric here
empty.body: No roll of this fabric and colour is in stock at the cut order's site.

rolls.give: The rolls picked give {given} of the {need} plies still needed.

why.shade: Lay {seq} is cut from shade {lay}: this roll is shade {roll}. One shade group per lay.
why.shrinkage: Lay {seq} is cut from shrinkage group {lay}: this roll is group {roll}. One shrinkage group per lay.
why.full: Lay {seq} has all its plies with the rolls picked.

rolls.rule: Allocating moves no stock: the fabric is issued when the lay is cut and its fabric used is confirmed at the table.

reconcile.title: Reconcile cut · {number}
reconcile.lines: Each size of each work order

held.reason: Line {seq} cut {cut} of {ordered}: pick a reason.
held.note: Line {seq}: Other needs the reason in words.

reconcile.hint: Reconciled, the cut order is closed: its figures feed the yield and the work orders' progress.

notice.notPrinted_one: {count} ticket was not printed: its label is shown below.
notice.notPrinted_other: {count} tickets were not printed: the last label is shown below.
notice.voidedReplaced: {number} is void; {replacement} was made for the same lay.

sheet.title: Lay sheet
sheet.failed: The cut order could not be read
sheet.nothingBody: Open the lay sheet from a cut order.
sheet.planned: Planned: the tickets are made at release, so this sheet has no barcode yet.
sheet.cancelled: This cut order is cancelled: its sheet is not for the table.
sheet.noLayBody: This cut order has no lay left.
sheet.rule: One shade and one shrinkage group per lay. Write a roll the table adds on an empty line; the table records the report on its tablet.
sheet.noTicket: No ticket yet: made at release.
sheet.footer: Paper for the cutting table: the tablet's scans and counts are the record.

shadeLot.none: No hide cut or allocated yet: the first hide sets the shade lot.
shadeLot.rule: One shade lot per order: the cutting table warns and a lead signs Cut anyway; another lot is reserved only with inventory.shade.override.

ofWorkOrder.title: Cut orders and lays
ofWorkOrder.none: No cut order names this work order: its fabric is cut on a cut order with its lays.
ofWorkOrder.hint: A cut order groups work orders of one material and colour: fabric is cut in lays from one marker; the lays, rolls and tickets are on the cut order.

balance.title: Issued, used and returned
balance.none: Nothing was issued to this work order yet.
balance.hint: Each hide issued to this work order: what was cut, wasted, sent back to stock and is still on it. Areas of different units are never added.

feedback.hint: A lot far below the plan is raised with its supplier as a claim on the lot: the supplier's quality and rating count it.
